exposure: Presence of portal vein tumor thrombosis (PVTT)
outcome: Postoperative pain (quantified as acute moderate to severe pain)
cohort: Participants were patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) undergoing transarterial chemoembolisation (TACE).
finding: The tumor location, the drug delivery method, and the presence of PVTT were independently associated with post-TACE pain, and a prediction model based on these factors was useful for identifying vulnerable patients.
